## Witness principles

- [ ] **Verbatim only.** Evidence is never generated, paraphrased or embellished. Any model output shown to a person is an exact substring checked in code.
- [ ] **No new outreach without consent.** Nothing new contacts a person except the rhythm they chose or an assistant offer they accept. Nothing is triggered by inferred mood.
- [ ] **Never argue with pain.** No scores, streaks, guilt, urgency, cheerleading or exclamation marks in product copy. Crisis line kept where it belongs.
- [ ] **Private by default.** No content analytics or logging of evidence text. Export and delete-everything still cover any new data.
- [ ] **Synthetic data only.** No real messages, emails, photos, exports, tokens or keys in code, tests, fixtures, docs or screenshots.

## Checks

- [ ] `bun run check` passes
- [ ] `swift test` in `apps/mac` passes (if Swift changed)
- [ ] Detector corpus gates pass (if the detector or lexicon changed)
- [ ] Tests added or updated
- [ ] Docs and guides updated (if behavior changed)
